summary: "Girlfriend" is Bobby Brown's debut solo single, released after he was thrown out of the R&B/pop group New Edition. It was taken from his first album, "King of Stage". The album failed to chart, but the single reached number one on the R&B charts for two weeks and peaked at fifty-seven on the Hot 100.
one_line: Bobby Brown's debut solo single "Girlfriend" hit number one on the R&B charts despite its parent album "King of Stage" failing to chart.
